verdict.rationale: CSC's Compliance Calendar in CSCNavigator automatically creates events for annual reports and related filing obligations and proactively emails alerts to unlimited users. CSC also sends a report of upcoming filings 45 days in advance, and it acts as registered agent across all 50 states and DC. missing for 10: explicit mention of franchise tax deadlines (only implied by 'related filing obligations'), explicit confirmation that coverage maps automatically to every state where CSC is agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
